summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 15 - 5 new enhancements for LendLedger. All 18 features verified working correctly via backend API tests (17/17 passed) and frontend UI tests.
passed_tests: Multi-select village filter component (MultiSelectDropdown.js) renders correctly
Multi-select shows chips/tags for selected villages with X remove button
Multi-select has search functionality inside dropdown
Backend accepts comma-separated villages (?village=Ahmedabad,BOARDI) and filters correctly
Rich text editor (Quill) has text color picker in toolbar (.ql-color)
Rich text editor has background color picker in toolbar (.ql-background)
Rich text formatting (bold, italic, underline, lists, alignment) works correctly
Rich text HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify on save and display
Delete entry confirmation popup appears when removing landed entry
Delete entry confirmation popup appears when removing received entry
Delete entry confirmation has Cancel and 'Yes, Delete' buttons
Delete entry Cancel does NOT remove the entry
Total Pending Amount card shows on account detail page (data-testid='total-pending-card')
Total Pending = Pending Principal + Pending Interest (verified: 9249.73 + 496.87 = 9746.60)
Page size dropdown has options: 10, 30, 50, 100 (data-testid='page-size-select')
Changing page size updates the table records
Confirmation popup appears before saving (create shows 'Confirm Create', update shows 'Confirm Update')
Filter state persists in localStorage (key: lendledger_accounts_filters) after Apply Filters
Filters restored in UI after navigation (Accounts -> Edit -> Back)
Clear filters removes localStorage entry
Status filter dropdown has 5 options: All Status, Continue, Closed, Renewed, Immediate Action Needed

multi_select_village_filter.details: MultiSelectDropdown component with search, chips, checkbox list. Sends comma-separated values to API (?village=Ahmedabad,BOARDI). Backend parses and filters using $in operator for multiple villages.

rich_text_color_pickers.details: Quill editor toolbar includes text color picker (.ql-color) and background color picker (.ql-background). HTML stored and rendered with DOMPurify sanitization.

delete_entry_confirmation.details: ConfirmDialog component shows 'Delete Entry' title with 'Are you sure you want to delete this entry?' message. Buttons: Cancel, Yes Delete. Works for jewellery, landed, and received entries.

total_pending_card.details: Purple-bordered card (data-testid='total-pending-card') shows Total Pending = total_pending_amount + total_pending_interest. Math verified: 9249.73 + 496.87 = 9746.60

page_size_dropdown.details: Select element (data-testid='page-size-select') with options 10, 30, 50, 100. Default is 10. Changing value triggers API call with new limit parameter.

save_confirmation_popup.details: ConfirmDialog shows before save. Create: 'Confirm Create' / 'Are you sure you want to create this entry?' / 'Yes, Create'. Update: 'Confirm Update' / 'Are you sure you want to update this entry?' / 'Yes, Update'.

filter_persistence.details: Filters saved to localStorage key 'lendledger_accounts_filters' on Apply. Restored on page load. Clear button removes localStorage entry. Persists across navigation.

status_filter_options.details: Status filter has 5 options: All Status (empty value), continue, closed, renewed, immediate action needed

critical_code_review_comments: MultiSelectDropdown.js: Well-implemented with search, chips, checkbox list, clear all functionality
AccountsPage.js: villageFilter.join(',') correctly sends comma-separated values to API
AccountsPage.js: Page size select with options 10, 30, 50, 100 - default 10
AccountFormPage.js: quillModules includes { color: [] }, { background: [] } for color pickers
AccountFormPage.js: deleteEntryConfirm state handles jewellery, landed, received entry deletion
AccountFormPage.js: showSaveConfirm state with ConfirmDialog for save confirmation
Backend accounts.py: Village filter parses comma-separated values and uses $in operator for multiple villages
seed_data_creation: Used existing accounts: ACC000062 (Sujal Sharaf) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 15 enhancements verified. Key changes: 1) MultiSelectDropdown component for village filter with search, chips, comma-separated API values. 2) Quill editor has color and background color pickers. 3) Delete entry confirmation for jewellery/landed/received entries. 4) Total Pending card = pending principal + pending interest. 5) Page size dropdown (10,30,50,100). 6) Save confirmation popup. 7) Filter persistence in localStorage. 8) Status filter has 4 options + All Status.
